questions.stem: The anticonvulsant class includes carbamazepine, sodium valproate, phenytoin, ____, lamotrigine, levetiracetam, gabapentin and pregabalin.
What is the core indication for anticonvulsant drugs?
Anticonvulsant mechanisms are very varied; which channels and receptors do they act on?
questions.answer: Voltage-gated calcium and sodium channels, GABA and glutamate receptors

questions.stem: In epilepsy, why should a single anticonvulsant agent be used where possible?
questions.answer: It avoids interactions, and a second agent rarely helps

questions.stem: What limits the use of phenobarbital as an anticonvulsant?
In status epilepticus, when is phenobarbital typically used?
questions.answer: When benzodiazepines and phenytoin fail to stop it
